Text-only card: no address, parcel or permit identity and no raw source links. Quotations keep the printed wording.
READY: loose-stock practice after tool/product checks
Use the owned Ryobi drill/driver; check its model instructions. Practice is on loose stock, not the
02. Dry-fit mock frame: use the separate dry 2×4×10 practice board for two 24-in plates and three 21-in
studs. Check the first cut square; dry-fit a 24×24-in rectangle. Use surplus offcuts for a separate
angle-and-screw trial; do not consume house parts.
The purchased Ryobi model is not recorded: use its own manual for modes and accessory changes; no clutch
number is prescribed. For the SD Connector candidate, use a ¼-in hex nut setter. No hammer-drill mode
for driving wood/connector screws. A good mock joint checks technique, not the wall's capacity.
Source family: r35-p13-practice.svg · printed page 13 of the R35 conditional plan (29 pages).
